about.title: Pasadena Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Grief doesn't follow a schedule, and neither do the questions that arrive after a sudden death. In Pasadena, public records counted four traffic deaths in 2025, alongside 922 injury collisions. Each of those numbers was someone's parent, partner, or child, and many of the crashes happened on corridors families drive every day: the I-210 Foothill Freeway, Colorado Boulevard, Fair Oaks Avenue, and Orange Grove Boulevard. Collision reports here tend to cluster on Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m., when commuters and weekend traffic overlap. A wrongful death claim in Los Angeles County is a civil action, separate from any criminal case, and it exists so surviving family members can recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Pasadena families with an independent attorney who takes wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery. You can ask questions before deciding anything.

whyChoose.title: What Pasadena Families Should Know Before Filing

items.title: Standing Is Limited, So Timing of Advice Matters
items.desc: Under California law, a spouse or domestic partner and children have the first right to bring a wrongful death claim, followed by certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out who in your family is eligible before any filing mistakes are made.

items.title: Two Years From the Date of Death, Sometimes Less
items.desc: California gives families two years from the date of death to file, but that window shrinks considerably when a government entity such as a city or Caltrans may share responsibility. Getting connected early protects the claim.

items.title: Civil Recovery Is Separate From Any Criminal Case
items.desc: Even if prosecutors in Los Angeles County pursue charges, your family's civil claim for funeral costs, lost support, and loss of companionship proceeds independently. One does not have to wait for the other.

items.question: My husband was killed in a crash on the 210 through Pasadena. Who is allowed to file?
items.answer: As his spouse, you are in the first group California recognizes for wrongful death standing, along with his children. If there are no surviving spouse, partner, or children, certain dependents and heirs may qualify instead. An attorney can confirm eligibility for everyone in your family and explain how the claim is brought on their behalf.

items.question: What if a Pasadena city vehicle or a road condition was involved?
items.answer: Claims against a government entity in California follow a much shorter timeline than the standard two years, and a formal notice usually has to be filed first. Missing that early step can end the claim entirely. This is one of the strongest reasons to speak with an attorney soon after a loss rather than waiting.

items.question: Do we have to pay anything to use LawProactive or to hire the attorney?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and there is no charge to be matched with an independent attorney. The attorneys in our network handle wrongful death cases on contingency, which means they are paid only if there is a recovery for your family.
